newsitem.title: POLAND: Poland to open local phone network tenders in Sept.
newsitem.headline: Poland to open local phone network tenders in Sept.

text.p: Poland's Communications Ministry plans to launch by September eight new tenders for local telephone networks in the country's big cities and their regions, the ministry's spokesman said on Wednesday.
"The ministry plans to hold tenders for local operators to reduce the monopoly of Telekomunikacja Polska SA (TPSA) in these regions," Zbigniew Zukowski told Reuters.

The regions for which the tenders will be held include the northern Gdansk, Sopot, Gdynia, the north-eastern Bialystok, eastern Chelm, southern Katowice, Bytom, Milkolow, Sosnowiec, Tychy, Gliwice and Krakow, the western Poznan, Slubice and Kostrzyn and the north-western Szczecin.
The ministry's move is line with its plan of privatising local networks, while keeping TPSA's control over long-distance connections.
